'''Shian''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]], during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark skin who wore gray and white [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]], Shian carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. They were stationed in the [[Farnel Outpost|Command Center]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] Farnel Outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
A class trainer for the Jedi Knight class on Balmorra, Shian first appeared in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
